What works on My Summer Car
My Summer Car in BETA: for now, you see and talk to each other (players, outfits, voice, chat) and the cars are shared. The rest (items, parts, money, jobs) comes over the next versions.
ME — Character (Outfit, Face, Car tabs): what the others see of you. Car: the SATSUMA of a new game. Sent content: CDs, radio, paint, posters… for your guests.
Map M: the players live and My Summer Car's places (Teimo's shop, Fleetari's repair shop, drag strip, rally…), with the roads, lakes and fields.
My Summer Car (BETA): money, items and jobs aren't shared yet; everyone sees them in their own game.
Tabs on the left, in three groups: Game (Players, Chat, Drag race, Rally), Me (Appearance, HUD, Graphics) and Advanced (Sync).

Drag race and Rally: the game's own events, when and where (drag race on Friday 6 am - 8 pm, rally on Saturday and Sunday 10 am - 6 pm), whether they're on or how long until the next one, and the players who are there.
Menu size (Small, Normal, Large) and its place (centre or left): F10 › Graphics › MWCoop menu. It also applies to the chat.

Most MSCLoader mods work in co-op as long as they only do things for you. On My Summer Car (BETA), MWCoop doesn't sync any mod yet: the objects or vehicles a mod adds are only seen by the players who have it. Here are also the mods to avoid.

Five themes: Summer (My Summer Car's, by default), Northern night, Daylight, Green aurora, Garage. Then the accent colour, the animated background (Off / Calm / Lively: fireflies at night, pollen by day), the cards' frosted glass, the density (Airy / Normal / Compact), the text size (80 to 110 %) and \"Follow Windows\". The preview on the right shows the result live; Apply keeps it.

Outfit: top, bottom, head and build. The choices come from the game's clothes, plus the 155 outfits given by Dom (\"Dom 12\"…). At the bottom, the Car strip: your SATSUMA colour and \"Custom paint…\".

The SATSUMA colour for a NEW game (the host's colour is given to the guests): sixteen shades, or \"Other colour…\" for your own; the first one is its original colour. No trim or VIN plate on the SATSUMA.

\"Custom paint…\": your own paint on the SATSUMA. \"Template\" opens the game's template (Images\\template.png): paint over it, then \"My image…\". In game, buy \"Custom paint made by artist\" at Fleetari's repair shop: the SATSUMA takes it. The host sends it to their guests (Sent content > SATSUMA paint).
MWCoop can replace the game's gauges (thirst, hunger, stress, urine, fatigue, money, day) with a black and yellow HUD, in My Summer Car's style. Vanilla, the default, keeps the game's own as is.
Card: a card in a corner, with the day and the money at the top and one row per gauge.
Alerts: a message at the top of the screen when you or a friend are very hungry, very thirsty or exhausted.
